pins.definition: Having nothing or nobody inside; not occupied.
Having nothing or nobody inside; not filled or occupied.
Containing nothing, or having no people inside.

situation: A cleaner is opening the door to a large, rectangular storage locker at the end of the day to find it completely devoid of items.
subject: the absence of contents inside a space
brief: A cleaner stands before the wide-open, heavy metal door of a large storage unit, revealing an interior that is stark and clean with not a single object inside. The floor and white walls of the unit are perfectly clear and unobstructed, emphasizing the total lack of contents within the frame.
prompt: A cleaner stands before the wide-open, heavy metal door of a large storage unit, revealing an interior that is stark and clean with not a single object inside. The floor and white walls of the unit are perfectly clear and unobstructed, emphasizing the total lack of contents within the frame. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
